[[File:Offensive_sensor_node.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An offensive sensor node mounted on a Mobile Defense Unit.]]
The '''offensive [[X2-a series sensor node|sensor node]]''' was a device mounted on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Mobile Defense Unit]]s. The device not only revealed a larger area, but was equipped with an [[energy discharge weapon]], enabling it to defend itself in the event enemies attacked.
